note: Every entry states WHY the negative is true. An exemption without a reason is rejected by the checker: muting a check silently is how a check dies. Review these when a capability's state changes.

exemptions.reason: Generated page. Its body is the engine's own spec summaries quoted verbatim, and those summaries are written in the negative on purpose -- 'no other default spec executes CROSS JOIN' is a promotion argument, not a claim the engine lacks CROSS JOIN. Sweeping a generated quotation of the authority against the authority is circular.

TRUE negative, and load-bearing. SQLsel DML refuses to store a NULL rather than coercing a blank -- see the SQLSEL_DML spec, which pins the fail-closed NULL control. Stored NULL exists on VFP-flavor tables; writing one THROUGH SQLsel DML does not, and the page must stay able to say so.

The page narrates its own past error -- it quotes the 2026-09-03 incident where the conformance table announced GROUP BY shipping in one cell and 'not implemented' one row away. Keeping the incident visible is the point of the paragraph; the quotation is history, not a current claim.
